entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and... I'm just not sure about it. The whole process is a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your order number?
Oh, sure, one moment. It's... VF78910. I got it maybe two or three weeks ago. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

Thank you. I see the order for the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
There's no fault, no. It's just... the color. It looked different on the website, and now that it's here, I don't think I like it. I'm not good with these things. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I understand completely. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've checked the policy here. It states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window to send the helmet back for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's it? I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you.

It's no problem at all. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied, especially when it comes to an important piece of safety equipment. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just attach that to the box and drop it at any post office.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much, Alex.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
